hero-portrait.jpg.prompt: Cinematic low-key editorial photograph of an elegant Mexican woman in her mid-40s, fictional, Valeria, standing in a dark luxury penthouse studio on the right third of the frame, three-quarter view, calm confident gaze, dark hair in a sleek low bun, tailored black suit, fine minimal gold jewelry, warm champagne-gold rim light, entire left half dark empty negative space, far city-lights bokeh behind, 85mm, shallow DoF, film grain, no text.
hero-portrait.jpg.notes: Reference identity for all Valeria images. Picked 1 of 3 candidates (others: P38WgjQ42C, Lw06bQaswO).

hero-portrait-mobile.jpg.prompt: Vertical version of the hero portrait: same woman (reference), thighs-up in lower two thirds, dark empty top third, same penthouse and bokeh, warm rim light.
hero-portrait-mobile.jpg.notes: hero-portrait (79dGjkbJAL) used as image reference for face/hair consistency. Picked 1 of 2 (other: 8aUbD4OIrU).

bio-portrait.jpg.prompt: Candid editorial photograph of the same woman in a cream silk blouse seated at a polished walnut desk beside a floor-to-ceiling window at dusk, looking down reading printed documents with a fountain pen, warm lamp light, deep blue-violet dusk and city lights, low-key.
bio-portrait.jpg.notes: hero-portrait (79dGjkbJAL) used as image reference for face/hair consistency. Picked 1 of 2 (other: JNXzsvXOq4).

bio-detail.jpg.prompt: Extreme close detail of a woman's hands signing a contract with a black-and-gold fountain pen, slim gold wristwatch, black tailored sleeve with cream cuff, black marble desk with gold veins, warm side light, illegible blurred paper lines, shallow DoF.
bio-detail.jpg.notes: No face reference needed (hands only). Picked 1 of 2 (other: KLGOuMnkqp).

timeline-2004.jpg.prompt: Documentary photograph of a very young woman (early twenties, same person younger), dark hair in a ponytail, dark blazer and white shirt, holding papers on a busy 2000s New York investment bank trading floor, CRT monitors glowing green/amber, traders blurred, mid-2000s film look.
timeline-2004.jpg.notes: hero-portrait (79dGjkbJAL) used as image reference for face/hair consistency. 2nd attempt to look younger; picked 1 of 3 (others: u56lvelQLD, s7Ti1E2l8e); 1st attempt candidates 5jAJEM4Kxe, kszyQpR16B unused.

timeline-2009.jpg.prompt: Cinematic photograph of the same woman in her late 20s, black coat, standing in a vast empty abandoned old building with tall arched windows, peeling plaster, golden light beams with floating dust, looking up with awe.
timeline-2009.jpg.notes: hero-portrait (79dGjkbJAL) used as image reference for face/hair consistency. Picked 1 of 2 (other: SyDZrhyUb8).

hero-loop.mp4.notes: Muted (no audio track). 2nd version. First version BhgHVcuoQR (start-frame only, pushIn camera) zoomed too much and is unused.

monogram-va.svg.magnificCreation: 6AhVywViJO (static vector, images_generate_svg, 375 credits); dtsQM9bXSL (images_animate_svg output, unused as delivered)
monogram-va.svg.prompt: Elegant luxury monogram of capital letters V and A interlocked, high-contrast serif, thin champagne gold outline strokes, transparent background.
monogram-va.svg.notes: Delivered file = the static vector with my own CSS/SMIL animation added (fade-in 2.2s, slow gold glow, shimmer sweep every 6s, prefers-reduced-motion respected). viewBox cropped tight (1286x1014). Magnific's animated variant rendered too dark, so it was not used.
